pyqs.independentSolution: Let last term L. L³=30/2(10/3+L)=50+15L. Factor L³−15L−50=(L−5)(L²+5L+10). Quadratic discriminant 25−40<0; only real L=5. d=(5−10/3)/29=5/87. All 30 terms are positive, and the total 125 matches L³.

targetQuestionText: The sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression is Sₙ = 3n² + 5n. What is the sum of the squares of its first ten terms?
